name: TearDrop ~Nijibito no Omoide~ Refrain
source:
Moments are fleeting...

When was I taught that life is everything?
When did I start to feel that it wasn't?
One summer night, Misato Kanzaki thinks long about the important things she lost and can't get back, like her reason for living. How long she's felt this way is unknown, but now it's every day. Lost in a haze, yearning for comfort.
Yet the basic rule of living for life's sake is all there is for the 2nd year high schooler.
An event moves her thoughts to the future.
Memories of the sky-spanning rainbow she didn't realize that day take shape at last in the form of words...

Even as dreams and desires are forever lost, she must live.
A game about the heavy, sad soul of one girl.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE098628.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
时光转瞬即逝……

我是什么时候被教导生命就是一切的？又是什么时候开始觉得并非如此的？一个夏日的夜晚，神崎美里长久地思考着她失去的、无法挽回的重要事物——比如她活下去的理由。她不知道自己这种感觉持续了多久，但现在每天都是如此。迷失在迷雾中，渴望着安慰。然而，为活着而活着的基本法则，就是这个高二女生所拥有的一切。一个事件将她的思绪引向了未来。那天她没有意识到的横跨天际的彩虹的记忆，终于以文字的形式成形了……

即使梦想和渴望永远失去，她也必须活下去。一个关于一个女孩沉重、悲伤的灵魂的游戏。
